title: Lovable-generated projects shipped Supabase tables readable without authentication
summary: Applications generated by Lovable embedded the public Supabase anon key in the client while omitting or mis-scoping row-level security policies, so an unauthenticated request could rewrite the query to select=* and read whole tables, and in places write to them. Matt Palmer and Kody Low found 303 such endpoints across 170 of the Lovable projects they scanned and published CVE-2025-48757 on 29 May 2025 after a March report went unresolved.
severity_rationale: Systematic exposure of user emails, phone numbers, payment records and developer API keys across roughly a tenth of the scanned application population, arising from a generator default rather than a one-off mistake.
